summary.goal: Expose REST endpoints for session management, enabling programmatic access to the ideation workflow.

acceptance_criteria.description: POST /api/ideation/sessions creates a new session with initial intent and optional initiative_id
GET /api/ideation/sessions lists sessions with optional status and initiative_id filters
GET /api/ideation/sessions/:id returns session details with transcript and understanding
POST /api/ideation/sessions/:id/messages appends a message to transcript
PUT /api/ideation/sessions/:id/understanding/:specialist updates specialist observations (freeform)
POST /api/ideation/sessions/:id/send-to-planner creates or updates plan from session
POST /api/ideation/sessions/:id/abandon marks session as abandoned
GET /api/ideation/sessions/:id/events SSE endpoint for real-time updates
GET /api/ideation/sessions/:id/confidence returns aggregate confidence score
All endpoints validate input with Zod schemas
Error responses follow existing API patterns (ApiError)

steps.title: Define API request/response schemas
steps.description: Create minimal Zod schemas for API endpoints (structure, not content validation)

acceptance_criteria.description: CreateSessionRequest = { initial_intent: string, initiative_id?: string }
ListSessionsQuery = { status?: SessionStatus, initiative_id?: string }
AppendMessageRequest = { role: TranscriptRole, content: string }
UpdateUnderstandingRequest = z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()) - freeform observations
SendToPlannerRequest = { goal?: string, context?: string } (optional overrides)
All response types match domain entities

steps.title: Implement session CRUD endpoints
steps.description: Create Express handlers for session CRUD

acceptance_criteria.description: POST /sessions returns { id, status, initiative_id?, source, transcript: [], understanding: {}, planner_sends: [], created_at, updated_at }
GET /sessions returns Session[] sorted by updated_at DESC
GET /sessions/:id returns full Session or 404
POST /sessions/:id/abandon updates status to 'abandoned', returns updated Session

steps.title: Implement message and understanding endpoints
steps.description: Create handlers for transcript and observations updates

acceptance_criteria.description: POST /sessions/:id/messages appends message with auto-generated id and timestamp
PUT /sessions/:id/understanding/:specialist accepts any specialist name (no enum validation)
PUT /sessions/:id/understanding/:specialist accepts freeform observations Record<string, unknown>
Both return updated Session

steps.title: Implement send-to-planner endpoint
steps.description: Create handler to send session understanding to planner

acceptance_criteria.description: POST /sessions/:id/send-to-planner works on active sessions
If planner_sends is empty: creates new plan via planner-core API
If planner_sends has entries: creates new plan version with updated understanding
Goal defaults to initial_intent, can be overridden in request
Appends PlannerSend to session.planner_sends (full payload snapshot)
Returns { session, plan_id, plan_version, plan_channel }

cross_scope_contract.request: { goal: string, context?: string, source: { type: 'ideation', session_id: string }, understanding?: Understanding, initiative_id?: string }

steps.title: Implement confidence endpoint
steps.description: Return aggregate confidence score from all specialists

acceptance_criteria.description: GET /sessions/:id/confidence returns { score: 0-100, breakdown: { Architect: 'confident', ... } }
Score is computed from computeAggregateConfidence(understanding)
Breakdown shows each specialist's confidence level

steps.title: Implement SSE events endpoint
steps.description: Create Server-Sent Events endpoint for real-time session updates

acceptance_criteria.description: GET /sessions/:id/events returns SSE stream
Events: transcript_updated, understanding_updated, status_changed, confidence_changed
Event format: { event: string, data: { session_id, ...changes } }
Connection kept alive with heartbeat

steps.title: Create event emitter for session changes
steps.description: Create IdeationEvents emitter that API handlers and SSE endpoint use

acceptance_criteria.description: IdeationEvents extends EventEmitter
Events: 'transcript', 'understanding', 'status', 'confidence'
API handlers emit events after successful operations
SSE endpoint subscribes to events for specific session_id

steps.title: Wire up routes and middleware
steps.description: Create routes.ts, integrate with Express app

JSON body parsing middleware applied
